// Generator of the Azure Shared Key vectors in src/upload/sharedkey.rs (test-only key).
// Run with the Go SDK azblob v1.6.0: copy this file to main.go in a module whose go.mod
// requires github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/storage/azblob v1.6.0 (as SRBackup agent
// does), then `go run .`; it prints each request and its Authorization header. Kept as .txt
// so no Go tooling sees it inside this Rust workspace.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore/policy"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore/streaming"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/storage/azblob"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/storage/azblob/blob"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/storage/azblob/blockblob"
)

type capture struct{}

func (capture) Do(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	fmt.Printf("REQ %s %s\n", req.Method, req.URL.EscapedPath())
	fmt.Printf("QUERY %s\n", req.URL.RawQuery)
	keys := make([]string, 0)
	for k := range req.Header {
		keys = append(keys, k)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	for _, k := range keys {
		fmt.Printf("H %s: %s\n", strings.ToLower(k), strings.Join(req.Header[k], ","))
	}
	fmt.Printf("CL %d\n", req.ContentLength)
	status := 201
	h := http.Header{}
	body := ""
	switch req.Method {
	case "DELETE":
		status = 202
	case "GET":
		status = 206
		body = "hello"
		h.Set("Content-Range", "bytes 0-4/5")
		h.Set("Content-Length", "5")
	}
	return &http.Response{StatusCode: status, Header: h, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(body)), Request: req}, nil
}

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	key := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte("dl-agent-backup test key, not a secret"))
	fmt.Printf("KEY %s\n", key)
	cred, err := azblob.NewSharedKeyCredential("devacct", key)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	opts := policy.ClientOptions{Transport: capture{}, Retry: policy.RetryOptions{MaxRetries: -1}, Telemetry: policy.TelemetryOptions{Disabled: true}}
	c, err := azblob.NewClientWithSharedKeyCredential("https://devacct.blob.core.windows.net/", cred, &azblob.ClientOptions{ClientOptions: opts})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if _, err := c.UploadBuffer(ctx, "backups", "db 1.bak", []byte("hello"), nil); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	bb := c.ServiceClient().NewContainerClient("backups").NewBlockBlobClient("db 1.bak")
	id := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte("block-00000001"))
	if _, err := bb.StageBlock(ctx, id, streaming.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader([]byte("hello"))), nil); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if _, err := bb.CommitBlockList(ctx, []string{id}, nil); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if _, err := c.DownloadStream(ctx, "backups", "db 1.bak", &blob.DownloadStreamOptions{Range: blob.HTTPRange{Offset: 0, Count: 5}}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if _, err := c.DeleteBlob(ctx, "backups", "db 1.bak", nil); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	_ = blockblob.CommitBlockListOptions{}
}
